How to generate a radiology inoive?

To generate a radiology invoice, choose the service for billing from the service list, enter the item code or name for the radiology service, select the item from the list, and click on the “Add” button. After that, follow the payment process as needed.

how to give discount for a radiology bill

To give a discount for a radiology bill, if any billing user has the privilege to give a discount, the discount can be applied on the billing screen up to the limits specified for that particular user. Additionally, if any date-wise discount is present for the patient against any service, the patient date-wise discount can be applied.
